column4: componentize-py and wasm-tools are not installed on this runner, and these eight tests need a real Python guest: they drive durable-await-signals and get-scope through the component boundary and read the bytes the guest was handed (cleat#3786) -- which only executing a guest can show. Eight WHOLE tests, none loops with t.Run, so there are no subtest names to ledger separately (cleat#3437). Declared under all four keys that reject a new ./engine/ toolchain skip -- multi-db/mysql, multi-db/mssql, cluster and test-go/engine -- as the sibling fragment test-python-guest-await-promise-outcomes.tsv does.

componentize-py and wasm-tools are not installed on this runner, and these two tests build a pre-fix-shaped Python component (the SDK's WIT with the old out-pointer declarations put back) and check it is refused before the host runs (cleat#3786) -- which only building and executing one can show. Two WHOLE tests. Declared under all four keys that reject a new ./engine/ toolchain skip, as the sibling fragment test-python-guest-await-promise-outcomes.tsv does.
